title: Astrid and the Kitchen
author: Ulyana Marchetti
blurb: Petra Underhill, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
